desc:
• LOAF AT FIRST SIGHT: Specially created flour for baking up delicious loaves and crusts your family will love

  • SLICE OF HEAVEN: Provides great elasticity, lift, and texture for easily shapeable bakes, like that perfect round pizza crust

  • ROLL WITH IT: A versatile flour that can help you create yeast breads, rolls, buns, and other baked goods from scratch; This large size bag is great for small business owners

  • FEEDING SOURDOUGH: Gold Medal Bread Flour has added nutrients and complex carbohydrates to feed your sourdough starter, fostering robust growth and a tangy flavor

  • CONTAINS: One 10 lb bag of Gold Medal Premium Quality Bread Flour
features:
Features

High-Protein Bread Flour: Contains more protein than all-purpose flour, ideal for strong gluten development.

Enriched & Unbleached: Fortified with iron and B-vitamins (niacin, thiamin, riboflavin, folic acid), and not bleached—maintains natural color and texture.

Presifted and Fine Texture: Ready to use with a smooth, consistent grind for even mixing.

Kosher Certified: Meets kosher dietary standards.

No Trans Fat or Cholesterol: A cleaner option for health-conscious bakers.

Large 10 lb Size: Great for frequent bakers or small-scale baking operations. 

Benefits

Superior Rise and Structure: High protein content supports strong gluten networks, giving bread more volume and a chewy interior.

Reliable Baking Results: Uniform blend and milling ensure consistent texture and performance every time.

Perfect for Sourdough and Yeast Breads: Supports active fermentation and rich flavor development in artisan recipes.

Versatile in the Kitchen: Ideal for rustic loaves, dinner rolls, pizza crust, bagels, and even chewy cookies or pretzels.

Bulk Value: The 10 lb bag reduces cost per use and ensures you always have flour on hand.

No Artificial Additives: Free from artificial colors and preservatives for a more natural bake.
ingredients:
Wheat flour, malted barley flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid.

Contains wheat ingredients
